text:
sally: Heads-up — dashboard flagged a p50 regression for /v1/generate in us-west after the routing policy rollout. p95/p99 unchanged.
ajay: I see that too. Console shows p50 bumped from ~40ms -> ~95ms for the endpoint. Per-route: fast-path median jumped, slow-path steady.
maria: Can you paste the endpoint rollup config? wondering if we accidentally switched merge semantics from count-weighted to route-fraction-weighted.
cheng: Rollout changed router to emit per-route sample_fraction metadata (for downsampling). Telemetry was supposed to re-weight by inverse fraction when merging; looks like the hotfix applied a normalisation that treats route p50s as equal weights.
patrick: I grabbed raw traces. Example distributions:
- fast-path: 800 samples, median 25ms, small micro-tail at 400ms (5 samples)
- slow-path: 200 samples, median 120ms
If you average route medians: (25 + 120)/2 = 72.5ms which is misleading. True combined median is ~40ms.
sally: Exactly — users expect the endpoint percentile to reflect the full request population, not the unweighted mean of per-route percentiles.
ajay: Reproducer script I ran (python):
```
# simplified merge
fast = [25]*795 + [400]*5
slow = [120]*200
combined = sorted(fast + slow)
print('combined_median', combined[len(combined)//2])
# -> ~40
```
maria: Immediate proposals:
1) revert the normalisation change so merges use raw sample_count as weight
2) surface sample_count alongside p50/p95/p99 in the console
3) add a per-route breakdown toggle default-off but quick to enable
cheng: I'll open a telemetry PR to change merge() to use explicit sample_count weights and add unit tests with contrived bimodal inputs to ensure median invariants.
patrick: UI: I'll wire the sample_count column and add the "Per-route breakdown" checkbox. Can hide by default but keep a pinned state per-user.
telemetry-bot: alert suppression: suppress p50 alerts for /v1/generate us-west for 12h per @sally while we stabilize.
sally: Thanks. Cheng, link the PR and the test vectors here. Ajay, can you add a quick metric that alerts if p50 shifts > 30% while p95/p99 unchanged? want to catch similar silent merges.
ajay: Yep — will add a short-lived Gate: p50-only-change rule and set to notify #eng-platform first.
maria: Follow-up: long-term we should document rollup semantics in the telemetry schema and add a console hint: "Endpoint percentiles are computed from merged samples; enable per-route breakdown to inspect subroute distributions."
cheng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/412 — includes tests and a changelog entry. PTAL @sally @ajay
sally: Reviewed. Approving the fix. Let's schedule the hotfix deploy in the next maintenance window and keep suppression until then. :thumbsup:
